text:
Maya: Quick sketch: compact legend with unit grouping + a tiny histogram per series. Hover expands details. Screenshot: <link>
Owen: Love the grouping. For mixed units, show a thin separator rule and a small badge like 'ms' or 'rps'. Legend rows must remain <= 2 lines.
Sam: Accessibility: histograms need keyboard focus and aria-label summaries. On focus announce: 'p50 120 ms, p95 450 ms'.
Priya: Outlier handling idea: default to 'chevrons' that indicate values exceed the visible range; clicking expands the Y to include them. Less surprise than automatic rescaling.
Maya: Agreed. Also add an explicit 'Apply soft-compress' toggle in chart settings for teams that want trend-preserving compression. Show a small 'nonlinear' badge when on.
Owen: Smoothing should be off by default on dashboards. Add a lightweight banner: 'Smoothing available for trend view' with 'Preview' action that opens a preview overlay.
Sam: Copy tweak: legend entries show 'requests · rps' (muted) instead of standalone 'requests'. If unit unknown show 'requests · ?' with inspector explaining the inference.
Priya: Performance: don't render per-point DOM for hists. Use canvas/sparkline image and provide precomputed bins from backend.
Maya: CSS snippet for showing inspector on keyboard focus:
```
.legend-item:focus .inspector { opacity:1; transform: translateY(0); }
```
Owen: Telemetry: emit events chart.outlier_mode and chart.unit_toggle. Default outlier_mode = 'chevron'.
DesignBot: Release note: default behaviors: Uniform Y = off for detail views, on for small-multiples dashboard template; outlier mode = chevron; smoothing = off.
Maya: I'll prototype in Storybook and add the copy. Pairing 9:30am tomorrow?
Owen: I'll join. Sam will do the a11y checklist.
Sam: Sending checklist after lunch.
Priya: Thanks all. Leaving microcopy final to Maya.
